mapper.sql: id, username, display_name, email, email_verified, password_hash, session_epoch, timezone, locale, last_login_at, profile_picture_url, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_user
SELECT id, display_name FROM app_user WHERE id IN #{id} ORDER BY id

SELECT u.id, u.display_name, u.profile_picture_url FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wm.status = 'active' AND u.id IN #{id} ORDER BY u.id
SELECT u.id, u.display_name FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wm.status = 'active' AND u.id IN #{id} ORDER BY u.id

SELECT u.id FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wm.status IN ('active', 'pending') AND (u.username LIKE #{query} OR u.display_name LIKE #{query}) ORDER BY u.id
SELECT FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT wr.id FROM workspace_member wm JOIN workspace_role wr ON wr.id = wm.role_id AND wr.workspace_id = wm.workspace_id WHERE wm.user_id = #{id} ORDER BY wr.id FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET account_deletion_reserved_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), account_deletion_reservation_owner = #{owner}, account_deletion_reservation_until = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) WHERE id = #{id} AND ( account_deletion_reservation_until IS NULL OR account_deletion_reservation_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT FROM app_user WHERE email = #{email}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM org_member om JOIN organization o ON o.id = om.org_id AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' WHERE om.user_id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM workspace_member wm JOIN workspace w ON w.id = wm.workspace_id AND w.lifecycle_state = 'active' JOIN organization o ON o.id = w.org_id AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' WHERE wm.user_id = #{id} AND wm.status = 'active' AND wm.role_id IS NULL AND wm.role IN ('admin', 'owner') UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM workspace_member wm JOIN workspace w ON w.id = wm.workspace_id AND w.lifecycle_state = 'active' JOIN organization o ON o.id = w.org_id AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' JOIN workspace_role_permission wrp ON wrp.workspace_role_id = wm.role_id WHERE wm.user_id = #{id} AND wm.status = 'active' AND wrp.permission IN ( 'AUDIT_READ', 'CAMPAIGN_MANAGE', 'CAMPAIGN_SEND', 'CONSENT_MANAGE', 'CUSTOM_FIELD_MANAGE', 'DOCUMENT_MANAGE', 'MEMBER_MANAGE', 'PIPELINE_MANAGE', 'PRODUCT_MANAGE', 'ROLE_MANAGE', 'RULE_MANAGE', 'SHARE_MANAGE', 'TAG_MANAGE', 'WORKSPACE_SETTINGS' ) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE username != '__connex_system__'

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.email, u.password_hash, u.timezone, u.locale, u.last_login_at, u.profile_picture_url, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id AND wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} WHERE u.username LIKE #{query} OR u.display_name LIKE #{query} OR u.email LIKE #{query} ORDER BY u.username LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (username, display_name, email, email_verified, password_hash, timezone, locale, profile_picture_url) VALUES (#{username}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{emailVerified}, #{passwordHash}, COALESCE(#{timezone}, 'UTC'), COALESCE(#{locale}, 'en'), #{profilePictureUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT session_epoch FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET session_epoch = session_epoch + 1, epoch_restamp_session_primary_id = NULL, epoch_restamp_epoch = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT epoch_restamp_session_primary_id AS sessionPrimaryId, epoch_restamp_epoch AS epoch FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id} AND epoch_restamp_session_primary_id IS NOT NULL AND epoch_restamp_epoch IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET epoch_restamp_session_primary_id = NULL, epoch_restamp_epoch = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
